interpretation.severe: best IoU drop >=0.10 or >0.5 to <=0.5; qualification change is not an asserted one-to-one TP assignment
interpretation.restored: trusted DBSCAN reaches BOTH old raw and old DBSCAN IoU; individual restored flags also supplied
interpretation.partial: trusted DBSCAN improves its raw IoU but has not reached both old baselines
interpretation.interaction: (trusted DBSCAN-old DBSCAN)-(trusted raw-old raw), descriptive difference of differences, not independent causal ablation
interpretation.native_IDs: Only scene and raw_gt_id paired; native prediction IDs never assumed stable
interpretation.scope: All four are fixed final400 geometry. Terminal postprocessing only, no rerun of online feedback; main object_observed_repair revision2 frozen=false
